feeds.title: Methadone.US Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about Opioid Treatment, Use Disorder, Mindset for Recovery, and more. Methadone.US is a privately owned, national online center dedicated to informing the public of the value of medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid-dependent individuals. Methadone.US is accessible from anywhere in the world but is specifically dedicated to U.S. consumers.

feeds.title: Arkansas Treatment Services Blog
feeds.description: Get more information and resources from Arkansas Treatment Services about opioid addiction, the treatment process, and going through addiction treatment and recovery. Our team members are experts in the field of opioid addiction and share both inspiration and expertise to help you.

The National Institutes of Health (NIH), a part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, is the nation's medical research agency making important discoveries that improve health and save lives.

feeds.title: The New Season Blog » Methadone Clinic
feeds.description: This category is about New Opioid Treatment and Recovery, treatment centers, and more. New Season is a leading provider of specialized quality care for Opioid Use Disorder (OUD), operating since 1986 with more than 80 addiction treatment centers in 20 states nationwide. We support the education and understanding of opioid addiction as a disease so that communities will support those affected by the disease to seek the help they need.

feeds.title: Lotus Recovery Centers » Methadone
feeds.description: This category is about Methadone Treatment, Addiction Treatment, Medication-Assisted Treatment, Addiction Recovery, and more. Lotus Recovery Centers exist to provide high-quality substance abuse treatment to those in our communities. We offer comprehensive addiction treatment that changes the lives of our clients. Through medication-assisted treatment, individual counseling sessions, group therapy, and abstinence-based treatment, we can help you or a loved one break free of addiction and discover life without drugs or alcohol.
